mid.name: Spirit Rend
mid.annotation: Basically just worse Crippling Headshot but I guess if you have Spirit Shredder you can upgrade it.

late.name: Greater Expansion
late.annotation: This is okay for ult and stun, ball too of course. If you have Ballistic Enchantment on ball you don't really need this until end game as a luxury replacement.

late.name: Indomitable
late.annotation: Very similar use case to Unstop, but mainly if one guy is jumping you instead of mass CC.

late.name: Mercurial Magnum
late.annotation: Seven's late game gun damage got hit hard, Magnum is still solid just not as strong as it used to be. Pretty low prio now.

late.name: Boundless Spirit
late.annotation: A huge global upgrade to your whole kit. Ton of spirit power and even more Regen.

late.name: Spirit Burn
late.annotation: Highest anti-heal in the game, but hard for you to activate. Expensive and unreliable but sometimes they do be healing.

late.name: Plated Armor
late.annotation: A good anti gun late game item, helps with on hit effects like Infernus and Haze, or M1s who like to build ricochet etc.

late.name: Lightning Scroll
late.annotation: Technically high impact but the stun duration isn't that long and I'm not a huge fan of sitting in Ult for long. Just try echo shard instead if you want CC.

late.name: Spellbreaker
late.annotation: Good if the Spirit damage is mainly burst, with debuff resist on top. Sometimes Resilience is better if it is more consistent chip or drain though.

late.name: Diviner's Kevlar
late.annotation: At the end, you'll be focused in your ult, causing you to need this shield against them. Get this at the end when you're all done snowballing spirit.

late.name: Transcendent Cooldown
late.annotation: Mainly just inferior to Duration, requires a bigger buy in to effect items and a ton of items you buy scale with duration anyway.
